svg.text: Platform is the sole session authority. IdP tokens never reach the browser. All paths emit immutable audit + WORM mirror.

g.text: · never expose IdP tokens to browser
Create UserSession (UUID, deviceCtx, lastAuthTime=now, expiresAt by policy)
Mint access token: { sub, sessionId, auth_time, [cnf.jkt if DPoP] }, signed JWT, short TTL
Mint id token (claims for the client)
Mint refresh token: opaque "{jti}.{secret}", 80B, hash stored Redis-side
Persist refresh record in Redis: { userId, jti, familyId, sessionId, tokenHash, status=ACTIVE }
Mint CSRF token, build cookies: refresh = HttpOnly + Secure + SameSite=Strict + path=/auth/token
Return access + id tokens in body; refresh + csrf in cookies
Emit AUTH_SUCCESS audit → DB hash-chain → WORM JSONL mirror

svg.text: 4 · Authenticated Request, runs on every protected endpoint

g.text: 1. Extract Bearer access token from Authorization header
2. Verify JWT signature + expiry (HMAC, server-side secret)
3. Token type must be ACCESS (no refresh / link / app tokens here)
4. Look up AppUser; require isActive=true and deprovisionedAt=null
5. Validate org membership (active org, active role)
9. If app.auth.dpop.enabled & token has cnf.jkt: verify DPoP proof JWS
· htm + htu + iat + jti (replay-protected in Redis)
· ES256 signature verified with embedded JWK; thumbprint must equal cnf.jkt
· checks auth_time claim ≤ 5 min old; else 401 STEP_UP_REQUIRED

svg.text: 5 · Refresh Cycle, proactive, every ~80 % of access TTL or on 401

g.text: Constant-time compare sha256(secret) vs stored tokenHash
Reload AppUser → check active, deprovisionedAt, membership
ip /16 changed + ua family changed → HIGH → revoke
Atomic Lua: ACTIVE → CONSUMED → mint successor
grace-replay limited to 1; 2nd reuse → kill family
Old jti now in CONSUMED state

svg.text: reuse / risk / deprovision → revoke family + session, audit, 401

g.text: Revoke this session (or all sessions for user)
IdP sign-out not equivalent, platform is sole authority
Step-up auth required for admin actions
Same path: revoke session + drop refresh
All admin actions stamped with actorRole
PKCE on all OAuth flows · OIDC validation (iss/aud/azp/exp/nbf/iat/nonce/alg/sig/tid/hd) · Atomic Redis refresh rotation with reuse detection · CSRF (cookie+header+Origin/Referer)
Per-endpoint rate limits + abuse detection · Anti-enumeration (uniform timing, min query length, result caps) · DPoP optional sender-binding · Step-up auth for sensitive ops
